# TextButton

- Inherits [`TextLabel`](textlabel.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("TextButton")`

A `TextLabel` that is meant to be pressed. It adds no property: `Activated`, `PointerEntered` and `PointerExited` are on `UIObject` because anything can be pressed, and what makes this a button is that it is the class a reader recognizes as one.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.
